devdoc.details: Fixed-profile collection/default primary assignments only; no deferred escrow or permits.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[EIP section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

artistRegistry().notice: Collection attribution authority bound to the manager's Core.

assetPolicyRegistry().notice: Shared token admission registry pinned by the split factory.

authorizationDigest((bytes32,bytes32,add.notice: Creator/platform digest under the reported PaymentIntentVerifier domain and a distinct type.

authorizationId(address,bytes32).notice: Manager authorization identity scoped to this adapter, artist and nonce.

authorizationUsed(address,bytes32).notice: Returns whether an artist nonce was used or cancelled.

buy((bytes32,bytes32,address,address,add.notice: Executes one atomic payment and mint; an empty payer signature only exempts the literal payer caller.

cancelAuthorization(bytes32).notice: Cancels the caller's artist nonce independently of payer consent.

cancelSale(bytes32).notice: Permanently stops new purchases while retaining the original sale record.

mintManager().notice: Mint execution dependency bound to the same Core as the artist registry.

paused().notice: Whether all purchases are paused; revocation remains available.

platformSigner().notice: Current platform signer for commercial sale authorizations.

primaryPolicy(uint256,bytes32).notice: Returns the canonical primary-policy commitment for a fixed collection/default profile.

proceeds(bytes32,address).notice: Exact successfully settled amounts for one profile and asset; excludes donations.

registerSale((uint256,bytes32,address,by.notice: Registers immutable commercial terms under the next canonical fixed-price sale ID.

revenueResolver().notice: Immutable primary-assignment resolver; distinct from the royalty resolver.

saleIdFor(uint256,bytes32,uint256).notice: Computes the SSA-IDENTITY sale ID with FIXED_PRICE kind 0.

saleRecord(bytes32).notice: Reads the full immutable sale terms and cancellation state.

setPaused(bool).notice: Owner governance pauses or resumes purchases.

setPlatformSigner(address).notice: Owner governance rotates the platform key and advances the signer epoch.

signerEpoch().notice: Monotonic signer epoch included in every commercial authorization.

splitFactory().notice: Factory used to verify the assigned immutable split wallet.

totalProceeds(address).notice: Exact successfully settled amounts per asset across profiles.

userdoc.notice: Current-stack fixed-price ERC-20 purchases with creator, platform and payer consent.
